instrumentationIssue: CP94 observed-engagement diagnosis used mean_minimum_range, which on finite-map movement can include movement-path closest approach rather than final post-Movement combat geometry.
interpretation: The path reached Range 1 at some point, but Side A produced essentially no missile launches. CP95 must not infer that a post-Movement Range-1 firing window existed from path closest approach. It will record final post-Movement readiness per trial and keep path closest approach as separate telemetry.
authorityBoundary: Diagnostic evidence only; this finding does not change gameplay rules or component values.
